div.:class: { [app.currentMode]: true, [app.layout]: true, 'fullscreen': app.isFullscreen, 'recordMode': app.recordMode,'showInstructions': app.showInstructions, 'commentsDisabled': !sessionUser.canComment, 'sourceHidden': +sketch.sourceHidden, 'darkMode': app.darkMode,'tutorial': sketch.isTutorial, 'showCodeOptions': app.showCodeOptions, 'fade':1, 'in': app.currentMode, 'dirty': sketch.isDirty, 'ligaturesEnabled': app.ligaturesEnabled, 'demo': app.demo }

body.div:
<div v-if="+user.active < 1" class="warningBox" style="width: 30%; margin-top: 50px; position: fixed; z-index: 1000;" v-cloak>
{{$t('user.suspension_warning')}}

div.:class: {active: app.currentMode == 'playMode', panel: true, hasFrameBorder: sketch.hasFrameBorder, showRuler: app.showRuler}

body.div:
<div id="introPanel" :class="{'active': app.instructionTimer < app.instructionDuration}" v-if="!sketch.newSketch && app.showInstructions && app.layout != 'layout_split' && sketch.license != 'none'" @mouseenter="app.instructionPaused=1" @mouseleave="app.instructionPaused=0" v-cloak>
				
{{sketch.instructions}}
				

					
					
						
							{{sketch.parentSketch.title}}
						
						
							{{sketch.parentSketch.fullname}}
						
					
				
				

					
						
						CC {{sketch.licenseObject.short}}
